newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stock market closed for public holiday.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stock market closed for public holiday.

text.p: The Seoul stock market is closed on Thursday for the Constitution Day public holiday. Trading will resume on Friday.
Stocks fell sharply on Wednesday. The composite index ended down 2.03 percent or 15.33 points at 739.72.
The drop was attributed to troubles with the Kia Group and news of an exchange of fire between South and North Korean soldiers in the Demilitarised Zone.

One of Kia's main creditor banks, the Korea First Bank, announced on Tuesday that Kia Motors Corp and 17 of the group's other 38 affiliates would be rescued under a scheme formed in April by financial institutions.
